title: Purple Energy Warrior Poses
description: Four sequential full-body poses of a muscular dark-skinned female warrior with short white hair, wearing a revealing purple and white tribal outfit with crystalline armor pieces and barefoot sandals. She manipulates bright purple magical energy that manifests as swirling particles, explosive bursts, and sharp crystalline shards.
prompt: A powerful dark-skinned female warrior with short spiky white hair and muscular build, wearing a revealing purple and white fantasy tribal outfit with crystalline shoulder and hip armor pieces, barefoot with purple anklets. Shown in four distinct full-body poses against a dark background: channeling swirling purple energy around her arms, raising both hands to summon a vertical beam of purple light, unleashing a massive explosive burst of purple crystalline shards from her hands, and standing in a ready stance with energy flowing around her body.
